title: Symplectic Split-Operator Propagators from Tridiagonalized Multi-Mode Bosonic Hilbert Spaces for Bose-Hubbard Hamiltonians
summary: In this methods paper, we show how to tridia\-go\-nalize two families of bosonic multimode systems: optomechanical and Bose-Hubbard hamiltonians. Using tools from number theory, we devise a rendering of these systems in the form of exact $D \times D$ tridiagonal symmetric matrices with real-valued entries. Such matrices can subsequently be exactly diagonalized using specialized sparse-matrix algorithms that need on the order of $D \ln(D)$ steps.
